note: The text box the baseline calibration (harness/fonts/baseline_calib.py) puts in its deck must be the writer's own, byte for byte (ruling M3-R37): packages/ooxml/test/text.test.ts checks that the writer writes `xml` for `box`, and harness/fonts/test_baseline_calib.py that the calibration does. Each run is black, opaque, with no spacing, rise or outline. The cases hold an italic run and a box of two runs whose last one differs in size, weight, slant, language and typefaces from the first, so that drift in the mark (a:endParaRPr, ruling M3-R37) fails both checks (ledger L145).
